geometry: A supplied homogeneous degree-two periodic guide of circumference one, implemented by addressed binary blank seam terms. This is a local one-dimensional comparison on a different space and time scaling. Outside-guide terms are isolated. Uniform single-load reference phases are removed.
scale: At h=1/N use physical time h squared per unit native exposure. Compare N=16,32,64,128,256. The original contact has kappa=8; the exchange-only control has kappa_eff=0. Three programmed repulsive contacts use kappa_eff=-h^alpha/4 for alpha=1/2,1,2, with the original local generator and the occupation-phase counterpulse. Equal single-load dispersion and the same hard-core exclusion in all arms.
probes: Determine the complex exchange coefficient from the adjacent-state boundary equation for physical relative momenta 1/2,1,2,4 at total momentum 1/2. Separately release the uniform superposition of all distinct pairs on a finite ring. Measure the complete minimal-separation distribution at physical times 1/32 and 1/8 and the uniform-state overlap. Compare native finite matrices with the proposed scattering limits. Record the strongly bound branch separately from the scattering interpretation of the original attractive guide.
